sent_bad: The document explains that in February 2024, the Japanese publication Nikkei suggested the proposed Nintendo Switch 2 would launch in March 2025 at the earliest, contradicting previous reports that pointed to 2024.

Given that the next console may arrive as early as March 2025 and Nintendo is supporting the current Switch until at least that point, the document's overall advice is to wait for an official announcement before holding your breath — or, in your case, before committing to the OLED model.
